repos_data.description: Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Bitbucket. Enables AI systems (LLMs) to interact with workspaces, repositories, and pull requests via tools (list, get, comment, search). Connects AI directly to version control workflows through the standard MCP interface.

A lightweight service that enables AI assistants to execute AWS CLI commands (in safe containerized environment) through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Bridges Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-aware AI tools with AWS CLI for enhanced cloud infrastructure management.
MCP server for AWS S3 — list buckets, browse objects, upload/download, presigned URLs

Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Confluence. Provides tools enabling AI systems (LLMs) to list/get spaces & pages (content formatted as Markdown) and search via CQL. Connects AI seamlessly to Confluence knowledge bases using the standard MCP interface.
AI-Powered Security Analysis for AWS — official MCP server. Analyze IAM policies and CloudFormation templates from any MCP client.

An MCP server to enumerate AWS IAM data, analyze effective permissions, and visualize access relationships across users, roles, and resources. Built for cloud security engineers who want fast, easy and effective insights into AWS identity risk

Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Jira. Equips AI systems (LLMs) with tools to list/get projects, search/get issues (using JQL/ID), and view dev info (commits, PRs). Connects AI capabilities directly into Jira project management and issue tracking workflows.
CLI tool which enables you to login and retrieve AWS temporary credentials using a SAML IDP
AWS operations by cli should be simpler
tfaws - zsh plugin for switching aws contexts
A utility for easily assuming AWS IAM roles from the command line.

repo_meta_data.description: Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for AWS Single Sign-On (SSO). Enables AI systems (LLMs) with tools to initiate SSO login (device auth flow), list accounts/roles, and securely execute AWS CLI commands using temporary credentials. Streamlines AI interaction with AWS resources.
